scope: Correction of product routing, native helper ownership, Cargo discovery, semantic environment and selection reuse. No full Rust coverage or performance qualification.

package.cargo_scope: Pinned Cargo is a metadata utility for compiler-owned calls. Arbitrary direct Cargo compilation is not a qualified Lustr frontend and may honor caller-selected external compilers.

entry.scope: synthetic entry failures and named real native witnesses; no whole-Rust or speed qualification
